result_preview.title: Hazardous Substance Compliance API
result_preview.shortDescription: Exposes hazardous substance inventory and regulatory compliance data for IT asset management.

result_preview.title: Incident Safety Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates safety incident detection and coordinates response workflows across ITSM.

result_preview.title: Occupational Safety Incident Coordinator
result_preview.shortDescription: Monitors and coordinates safety incidents with hazardous substance involvement for compliance.

result_preview.title: Hazardous Substance Inventory Exchange API
result_preview.shortDescription: Retrieves and manages hazardous substance inventory data for compliance tracking.
result_preview.description: Exposes comprehensive hazardous substance inventory records including chemical properties, quantities, storage locations, and usage patterns. Manages real-time updates to substance catalogs and provides access to historical inventory changes for audit trails. Enables integration with regulatory reporting systems and third-party compliance platforms for seamless data exchange.

result_preview.title: Hazardous Substance Regulatory Validation API
result_preview.shortDescription: Validates hazardous substances against regulatory requirements and compliance standards.
result_preview.description: Exposes hazardous substance data for real-time regulatory validation against global compliance frameworks. Retrieves substance classifications, regulatory thresholds, and restriction status to ensure materials meet current safety and environmental standards. Manages substance compliance attestation and provides access to regulatory change notifications.
